description: Frozen aggregate evidence for the 2 November 2026 corpus analysis and paired-probe review. Program bytes, individual diffs and private cases remain in local data.

pair-summary.json.method: Python lexical tokens, not model tokens. SequenceMatcher autojunk=False; changed=max(deleted,inserted) per block. Comments normalized with repository function. No execution.

method.lexical: character trigrams, min train df 2, top 2000, sublinear TF-IDF, unit norm
method.cv: 5 folds grouped by task, deterministic SHA256 seed 17; all preprocessing fit on train fold only
method.bootstrap: 2000 resamples of held-out tasks; fixed predictions; not model-retraining uncertainty

analysis-manifest.json.scope: Retained91, construction and development only; static program review, frozen audit/monitor summaries, and lightweight classifier probes. No evaluated program or language model executed.
limitations: Semantic classifications are manual static assessments.
Probe validation is task-disjoint but remains exploratory on a small acquisition-specific corpus.
Development is not an untouched final evaluation set.
Historical monitor results do not qualify the proposed thinking-off binary configuration.

review-manifest.json.purpose: Post-review paired-ranking diagnostics, supplementary to single-program classification. No benign reference is available at monitor inference.
review-manifest.json.methods: Fixed earlier probes; source-pairs grouped within tasks for descriptive bootstrap and sign-flip tests; exploratory post-hoc analyses, not confirmatory p-values.

external_entrypoint_ablation.status: Reviewer-produced source-feature ablation; inspected code/results, not behavior-validated canonicalization.
